text: Revise docs/design/parallel-jobs.md to answer its review (docs/design/reviews/parallel-jobs-review-1.md), findings F1 to F8. F1 is now addressed by native PR landing, which shipped today: each job lands through its own pull request by squash, and after each landing Athena rebuilds the local branch on the merged commit (docs/design/native-pr-landing.md). Build on that. Prefer running each job as its own process over sharing Athena across threads, unless the design shows threads are safe (F2). Say how CHANGELOG.md, docs/decisions.md numbering and other shared append-only files stop colliding (F3). Design only; the build is a later job.
